test_title: PYST 5: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.

Air Travel is the _____ growing emitter of climate change gases.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e. **'Fastest'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct alternative to fill in the blank in the sentence "Air Travel is the _____ growing emitter of climate change gases" is: **'fastest'.**
 
• The word **"fastest"** is the superlative form of the adjective "fast". 
 
• It is** used to compare** three or more items or entities and suggests that the one being described surpasses all others in speed. 
 
• Here it implies that of all sources of climate change gases, air travel is growing at the fastest rate.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'**Air Travel is the fastest growing emitter of climate change gases.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fastly:** There is no such word in English. The adverb form of "fast" is "fast" itself.
 
• **Fast: **This is the base form of the adjective, used to describe something moving at high speed. But it's not appropriate here because the sentence requires a superlative form.
 
• **Fasting: **This word refers to the act of abstaining from all or some kinds of food or drink, especially as a religious observance. It is unrelated to the context of the sentence.
